biotools.summary: MAPIT-seq is a novel method for co-profiling RNA-protein interactions and transcriptome in single cells and tissues. It uses an antibody-directed editing strategy to map in situ RBP-RNA interactions and gene expression, expanding multi-omics profiling for studying post-transcriptional regulation.
